RECOVERY
====================================================================================================
correct actual factors recovered = 300/300
recovery rate                    = 100.0000%

====================================================================================================
MATHEMATICAL INTERPRETATION
====================================================================================================

We now work with:

    d = |p-q|

and:

    s^2 = 4n + d^2

For the true factor pair, s is therefore exactly recoverable from d whenever 4n+d² is a square.

Modulo each close prime:

    s² ≡ 4n + d² (mod r_i)

so every true d must satisfy three quadratic-residue conditions.

The search therefore becomes:

    all possible d
          |
          v
    QR(r1)
          |
          v
    QR(r2)
          |
          v
    QR(r3)
          |
          v
    exact square
          |
          v
    p=(s-d)/2, q=(s+d)/2

The crucial comparison with the previous experiment is that there is no p enumeration and no s enumeration.

The difference domain contains only 45,001 even candidates for this factor interval.

The strongest possible observation would be that the three-modulus QR intersection is substantially smaller than the expected 1/8 random survival rate, or that the actual d repeatedly appears unusually early in the surviving candidate ordering.

total runtime = 36.454 seconds
